notes: «أخبرني علي بن حاتم فيما كتب إلي» : the written transmission is the link's manner, not a name; «فيما كتب إلي» is left out.
«عن سماعة وغيره» : «غيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter in the same level.
«عن أبي عبد الله ع» : the Imam is named after «عن», so he is a narrator; his words are the saying.
«12-» is the report number and is left out.
